content.short: Traxed enables merchants to create a blockchain-based supply chain for easy traceability of products.
content.description: In today’s global, rapidly changing market, customers seek assurance about the quality of the products they buy. Transparent sellers want to show that products are manufactured under strict standards for component quality and worker welfare. The most effective way to keep supply chains clean and compliant is a publicly verifiable system that certifies data reliability. With Traxed, companies can easily validate and certify the claims they and their suppliers make, all at a low cost.
content.meta: Traxed is an infrastructure platform. Discover Traxed and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
